gt-reset-confirm: Reset ALL tracker progress for this game?
gt-element-tip: %1 — weak to %2 (deal extra damage; block/deflect %2 attacks)
df-subtitle: Every enemy and boss, grouped by element. The game hides elements, but they matter: each element has an OPPOSITE — Fire ↔ Water, Air ↔ Earth, Light ↔ Dark. Hit a foe with its opposite element for extra damage; wear/equip the matching element to reduce damage and deflect attacks with a shield. Hover an element pill to see its opposite.
kp-note: Backs up / restores ALL Darkest Faerie tracker progress on this site as a JSON file.
kp-import-confirm: Importing will overwrite the saved progress of every tracker on this site with the file's contents. Continue?
kp-import-error: That file could not be read as a progress export.
note-bosses: Bosses in encounter order. Watch the element column — some foes return in a later Act with a different alignment (the Ixi Chieftain is Earth in Act 1, Dark in Act 3).
note-air: Air enemies are weak to Earth. Equip Earth to block/deflect their attacks.
note-earth: Earth enemies are weak to Air.
note-dark: Dark enemies are weak to Light.
note-fire: Fire enemies are weak to Water.
note-light: Light enemies are weak to Dark.
note-water: Water enemies are weak to Fire.
